description: Audit the keys in a JSON document: keys that differ only by case, keys containing non-identifier characters, total key count, occurrence frequency and maximum nesting depth. Choose this before generating a schema or code from a JSON sample, to find keys that differ only by case, keys with non-identifier characters, and the document's nesting depth. Do not choose this when you need the document validated against a schema; use json-schema-validation. Example requests: Are the keys in this JSON consistent? | Audit this JSON for casing mistakes before I generate a schema. | How deep is this JSON and what keys does it use?

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

content.description: The customer's input.json, as text. Supported: JSON. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

inputs.title: JSON key audit: inconsistent casing, odd characters and depth

payment_signature.description: x402 payment payload; required for a priced capability (see submit_job).

quote_id.description: The quote_id from POST /v1/jobs; required when priced.
